title: Story premise EDU059: The Definition-of-Done Turnstile
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (work/process). Hook: Done in whose sense of the word? Takeaway/theme: Define completion in observable terms before relying on a status label.
description: A team wants to close a task, but one person means rendered while another means reviewed and delivered. A shared set of observable completion checks aligns the label before the task exits.
